WITH controls AS (
  SELECT
    'governance' AS pillar,
    waf_id,
    principle,
    description,
    score_percentage,
    threshold_percentage,
    threshold_met,
    CAST(score_percentage AS DOUBLE) AS score_weighted
  FROM
    (
      WITH delta_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_tables,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN data_source_format IN ('DELTA', 'ICEBERG', 'DELTASHARING') THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as delta_tables
        FROM
          system.information_schema.tables
        WHERE
          table_catalog != 'hive_metastore'
          AND table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
      ),
      lineage_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(DISTINCT
            CONCAT(t.table_catalog, '.', t.table_schema, '.', t.table_name)
          ) as total_tables,
          COUNT(DISTINCT
            CASE
              WHEN
                tl.target_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
              THEN
                CONCAT(t.table_catalog, '.', t.table_schema, '.', t.table_name)
            END
          ) as lineage_tables
        FROM
          system.information_schema.tables t
            LEFT JOIN system.access.table_lineage tl
              ON CONCAT(t.table_catalog, '.', t.table_schema, '.', t.table_name)
                = tl.target_table_full_name
        WHERE
          t.table_catalog != 'hive_metastore'
          AND t.table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
      ),
      metadata_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_tables,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN comment IS NOT NULL THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as tables_with_comments,
          CASE
            WHEN
              EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.table_tags
              )
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  COUNT(*)
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.tables
                WHERE
                  table_catalog != 'hive_metastore'
                  AND table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
              )
            ELSE 0
          END as tables_with_tags
        FROM
          system.information_schema.tables t
        WHERE
          table_catalog != 'hive_metastore'
          AND t.table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
      ),
      waf_status AS (
        SELECT
          waf_id,
          principle,
          description,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-01-03'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (lineage_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  lineage_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-01-04'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (tables_with_comments * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  metadata_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-01-05'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (tables_with_tags * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  metadata_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-02-01'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.information_schema.row_filters
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-02-02'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.access.audit
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-02-03'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.information_schema.tables
                      WHERE
                        table_catalog = 'system'
                        AND table_schema = 'marketplace'
                        AND table_name = 'listing_access_events'
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-03-02'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.information_schema.tables
                      WHERE
                        table_name LIKE '%_drift_metrics'
                        OR table_name LIKE '%_profile_metrics'
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-03-03'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  delta_usage
              )
            ELSE 0
          END AS current_percentage,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-01-03'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (lineage_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  lineage_usage
              ) >= 50
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-01-04'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (tables_with_comments * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  metadata_usage
              ) >= 50
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-01-05'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.table_tags
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-02-01'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.row_filters
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-02-02'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.access.audit
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-02-03'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.tables
                WHERE
                  table_catalog = 'system'
                  AND table_schema = 'marketplace'
                  AND table_name = 'listing_access_events'
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-03-02'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.tables
                WHERE
                  table_name LIKE '%_drift_metrics'
                  OR table_name LIKE '%_profile_metrics'
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'DG-03-03'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  delta_usage
              ) >= 80
            THEN
              'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
          END AS implemented
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *
            FROM
              VALUES
                ('DG-01-03', 'Unify data and AI management', 'Track data and AI lineage'),
                ('DG-01-04', 'Unify data and AI management', 'Add comments to metadata'),
                ('DG-01-05', 'Unify data and AI management', 'Enable easy data discovery'),
                (
                  'DG-02-01',
                  'Unify data and AI security',
                  'Centralize access control (row/column level)'
                ),
                ('DG-02-02', 'Unify data and AI security', 'Configure audit logging'),
                ('DG-02-03', 'Unify data and AI security', 'Audit data platform events'),
                (
                  'DG-03-02',
                  'Establish data quality standards',
                  'Use data quality tools and profiling'
                ),
                (
                  'DG-03-03',
                  'Establish data quality standards',
                  'Enforce standardized data formats'
                ) AS waf(waf_id, principle, description)
          )
      )
      SELECT
        waf_id,
        principle,
        description,
        ROUND(current_percentage, 1) as score_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-01-03' THEN 50
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-01-04' THEN 50
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-01-05' THEN 50
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-02-01' THEN 100
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-02-02' THEN 100
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-02-03' THEN 100
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-03-02' THEN 100
          WHEN waf_id = 'DG-03-03' THEN 80
        END as threshold_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN implemented = 'Yes' THEN 'Met'
          ELSE 'Not Met'
        END as threshold_met,
        implemented
      FROM
        waf_status
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'interoperability_usability' AS pillar,
    waf_id,
    principle,
    description,
    score_percentage,
    threshold_percentage,
    threshold_met,
    CAST(score_percentage AS DOUBLE) AS score_weighted
  FROM
    (
      WITH delta_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS total_tables,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN data_source_format IN ('DELTA', 'ICEBERG', 'DELTASHARING') THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS delta_tables
        FROM
          system.information_schema.tables
        WHERE
          table_catalog != 'hive_metastore'
          AND table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
      ),
      uc_adoption AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS total_tables,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN table_catalog != 'hive_metastore' THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS uc_tables
        FROM
          system.information_schema.tables
        WHERE
          table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
      ),
      serverless_compute AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS total_warehouses,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN warehouse_type IN ('PRO', 'SERVERLESS') THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS serverless_warehouses
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM
              system.compute.warehouses
            WHERE
              delete_time IS NULL
          )
        WHERE
          rn = 1
      ),
      waf_status AS (
        SELECT
          waf_id,
          principle,
          description,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'IU-01-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  delta_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'IU-04-03'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (uc_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  uc_adoption
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'IU-03-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN
                      total_warehouses > 0
                    THEN
                      (serverless_warehouses * 100.0 / total_warehouses)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  serverless_compute
              )
            ELSE 0
          END AS current_percentage,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'IU-01-01'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  delta_usage
              ) >= 80
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'IU-04-03'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (uc_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  uc_adoption
              ) >= 80
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'IU-03-01'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN
                      total_warehouses > 0
                    THEN
                      (serverless_warehouses * 100.0 / total_warehouses)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  serverless_compute
              ) >= 50
            THEN
              'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
          END AS implemented
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *
            FROM
              VALUES
                ('IU-01-01', 'Use open and standard formats', 'Adopt Delta/Iceberg for all tables'),
                ('IU-04-03', 'Centralize data management', 'Use Unity Catalog for all assets'),
                (
                  'IU-03-01',
                  'Leverage serverless compute',
                  'Use Pro/Serverless SQL warehouses'
                ) AS waf(waf_id, principle, description)
          )
      )
      SELECT
        waf_id,
        principle,
        description,
        ROUND(current_percentage, 1) as score_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN waf_id = 'IU-01-01' THEN 80
          WHEN waf_id = 'IU-04-03' THEN 80
          WHEN waf_id = 'IU-03-01' THEN 50
        END as threshold_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN implemented = 'Yes' THEN 'Met'
          ELSE 'Not Met'
        END as threshold_met,
        implemented
      FROM
        waf_status
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'operational_excellence' AS pillar,
    waf_id,
    principle,
    description,
    score_percentage,
    threshold_percentage,
    threshold_met,
    CAST(score_percentage AS DOUBLE) AS score_weighted
  FROM
    (
      WITH job_population AS (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM
              system.lakeflow.jobs
            WHERE
              delete_time IS NULL
          )
        WHERE
          rn = 1
      ),
      job_stats AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS total_jobs,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN trigger_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS scheduled_jobs,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN
                run_as_user_name IS NOT NULL
                AND run_as_user_name != ''
              THEN
                1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS jobs_with_run_as
        FROM
          job_population
      ),
      waf_status AS (
        SELECT
          waf_id,
          principle,
          description,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'OE-01-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_jobs > 0 THEN (scheduled_jobs * 100.0 / total_jobs)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  job_stats
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'OE-01-02'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_jobs > 0 THEN (jobs_with_run_as * 100.0 / total_jobs)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  job_stats
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'OE-02-01'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.lakeflow.jobs
                      WHERE
                        delete_time IS NULL
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            ELSE 0
          END AS current_percentage,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'OE-01-01'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_jobs > 0 THEN (scheduled_jobs * 100.0 / total_jobs)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  job_stats
              ) >= 50
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'OE-01-02'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_jobs > 0 THEN (jobs_with_run_as * 100.0 / total_jobs)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  job_stats
              ) >= 50
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'OE-02-01'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.lakeflow.jobs
                WHERE
                  delete_time IS NULL
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
          END AS implemented
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *
            FROM
              VALUES
                ('OE-01-01', 'Automate operational tasks', 'Schedule jobs with triggers'),
                ('OE-01-02', 'Automate operational tasks', 'Configure run_as for jobs'),
                (
                  'OE-02-01',
                  'Monitor and observe workloads',
                  'Use Lakeflow Jobs for orchestration'
                ) AS waf(waf_id, principle, description)
          )
      )
      SELECT
        waf_id,
        principle,
        description,
        ROUND(current_percentage, 1) as score_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN waf_id = 'OE-01-01' THEN 50
          WHEN waf_id = 'OE-01-02' THEN 50
          WHEN waf_id = 'OE-02-01' THEN 100
        END as threshold_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN implemented = 'Yes' THEN 'Met'
          ELSE 'Not Met'
        END as threshold_met,
        implemented
      FROM
        waf_status
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'security_compliance_privacy' AS pillar,
    waf_id,
    principle,
    description,
    score_percentage,
    threshold_percentage,
    threshold_met,
    CAST(score_percentage AS DOUBLE) AS score_weighted
  FROM
    (
      WITH active_jobs AS (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM
              system.lakeflow.jobs
            WHERE
              delete_time IS NULL
          )
        WHERE
          rn = 1
      ),
      sp_stats AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS total_jobs,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN
                run_as IS NOT NULL
                AND run_as != creator_id
              THEN
                1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS sp_jobs
        FROM
          active_jobs
      ),
      waf_status AS (
        SELECT
          waf_id,
          principle,
          description,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'SCP-01-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_jobs > 0 THEN (sp_jobs * 100.0 / total_jobs)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  sp_stats
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'SCP-02-01'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.access.audit
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'SCP-03-01'
            THEN
              (
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    EXISTS (
                      SELECT
                        1
                      FROM
                        system.information_schema.row_filters
                    )
                  THEN
                    100
                  ELSE 0
                END
              )
            ELSE 0
          END AS current_percentage,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'SCP-01-01'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_jobs > 0 THEN (sp_jobs * 100.0 / total_jobs)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  sp_stats
              ) >= 50
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'SCP-02-01'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.access.audit
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'SCP-03-01'
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT
                  1
                FROM
                  system.information_schema.row_filters
              )
            THEN
              'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
          END AS implemented
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              *
            FROM
              VALUES
                (
                  'SCP-01-01',
                  'Implement identity management',
                  'Use service principals for job execution'
                ),
                ('SCP-02-01', 'Enable audit and compliance', 'Configure audit logging'),
                (
                  'SCP-03-01',
                  'Protect sensitive data',
                  'Implement row/column-level security'
                ) AS waf(waf_id, principle, description)
          )
      )
      SELECT
        waf_id,
        principle,
        description,
        ROUND(current_percentage, 1) as score_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN waf_id = 'SCP-01-01' THEN 50
          WHEN waf_id = 'SCP-02-01' THEN 100
          WHEN waf_id = 'SCP-03-01' THEN 100
        END as threshold_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN implemented = 'Yes' THEN 'Met'
          ELSE 'Not Met'
        END as threshold_met,
        implemented
      FROM
        waf_status
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'reliability' AS pillar,
    waf_id,
    principle,
    description,
    score_percentage,
    threshold_percentage,
    threshold_met,
    CAST(score_percentage AS DOUBLE) AS score_weighted
  FROM
    (
      WITH delta_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_tables,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN data_source_format IN ('DELTA', 'ICEBERG', 'DELTASHARING') THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as delta_tables
        FROM
          system.information_schema.tables
        WHERE
          table_catalog != 'hive_metastore'
          AND table_type IN ('MANAGED', 'EXTERNAL')
      ),
      dlt_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_compute_usage,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN billing_origin_product = 'DLT' THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as dlt_compute_usage
        FROM
          system.billing.usage
        WHERE
          usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
          AND usage_type LIKE '%COMPUTE%'
      ),
      model_serving_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_ml_compute,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING' THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as serving_compute
        FROM
          system.billing.usage
        WHERE
          usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
          AND (
            usage_type LIKE '%COMPUTE%'
            OR billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'
          )
      ),
      serverless_usage AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_compute,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN
                usage_type LIKE '%SERVERLESS%'
                OR sku_name LIKE '%SERVERLESS%'
              THEN
                1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as serverless_count
        FROM
          system.billing.usage
        WHERE
          usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
          AND usage_type LIKE '%COMPUTE%'
      ),
      autoscale_clusters AS (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) as total_clusters,
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN ifnull(max_autoscale_workers, 0) > 0 THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) as autoscale_clusters
        FROM
          (
            SELECT
              max_autoscale_workers,
              delete_time,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM
              system.compute.clusters
          )
        WHERE
          rn = 1
          AND delete_time IS NULL
      ),
      waf_status AS (
        SELECT
          waf_id,
          principle,
          description,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-01-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  delta_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-02-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN
                      total_compute_usage > 0
                    THEN
                      (dlt_compute_usage * 100.0 / total_compute_usage)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  dlt_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-03-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_ml_compute > 0 THEN (serving_compute * 100.0 / total_ml_compute)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  model_serving_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-04-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_compute > 0 THEN (serverless_count * 100.0 / total_compute)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  serverless_usage
              )
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-05-01'
            THEN
              (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_clusters > 0 THEN (autoscale_clusters * 100.0 / total_clusters)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  autoscale_clusters
              )
            ELSE 0
          END AS current_percentage,
          CASE
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-01-01'
              AND (
                SELECT
                  CASE
                    WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                    ELSE 0
                  END
                FROM
                  delta_usage
              ) >= 80
            THEN
              'Yes'
            WHEN
              waf_id = 'RE-02-01'
              AND (

        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN ifnull(max_autoscale_workers, 0) > 0 THEN 1

      FROM
        (
          SELECT
            max_autoscale_workers,
            delete_time,

          FROM
            system.compute.clusters
        )
      WHERE
        rn = 1
        AND delete_time IS NULL

    waf_status AS (
      SELECT
        waf_id,
        principle,
        description,
        CASE
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-01-01'
          THEN
            (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                delta_usage
            )
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-02-01'
          THEN
            (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    total_compute_usage > 0
                  THEN
                    (dlt_compute_usage * 100.0 / total_compute_usage)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                dlt_usage
            )
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-03-01'
          THEN
            (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_ml_compute > 0 THEN (serving_compute * 100.0 / total_ml_compute)
                  ELSE 0

              FROM

          WHEN

          THEN
            (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_compute > 0 THEN (serverless_count * 100.0 / total_compute)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                serverless_usage
            )
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-05-01'
          THEN
            (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_clusters > 0 THEN (autoscale_clusters * 100.0 / total_clusters)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                autoscale_clusters
            )
          ELSE 0
        END AS current_percentage,
        CASE
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-01-01'
            AND (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_tables > 0 THEN (delta_tables * 100.0 / total_tables)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                delta_usage
            ) >= 80
          THEN
            'Yes'
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-02-01'
            AND (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    total_compute_usage > 0
                  THEN
                    (dlt_compute_usage * 100.0 / total_compute_usage)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                dlt_usage
            ) >= 10
          THEN
            'Yes'
          WHEN
            waf_id = 'RE-03-01'
            AND (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_ml_compute > 0 THEN (serving_compute * 100.0 / total_ml_compute)
                  ELSE 0
                END
              FROM
                model_serving_usage
            ) >= 10
          THEN

            AND (
              SELECT
                CASE
                  WHEN total_compute > 0 THEN (serverless_count * 100.0 / total_compute)
                  ELSE 0

              FROM

                  ELSE 0

            ) >= 50
          THEN
            'Yes'
          ELSE 'No'
        END AS implemented
      FROM
        (
          SELECT

          FROM
            VALUES

              ('RE-02-01', 'Design for reliability', 'Use declarative pipelines (DLT)'),
              ('RE-03-01', 'Design for reliability', 'Use model serving endpoints'),
              ('RE-04-01', 'Leverage managed services', 'Adopt serverless compute'),
              ('RE-05-01', 'Leverage managed services', 'Enable cluster autoscaling') AS waf(
              waf_id, principle, description
            )
        )
    )
    SELECT

      description,

        WHEN waf_id = 'RE-02-01' THEN 10
        WHEN waf_id = 'RE-03-01' THEN 10

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    :date_range.min AS start_ts,
    :date_range.max AS end_ts,
    CAST(:date_range.min AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(:date_range.max AS DATE) AS end_date
),

  SELECT
    usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN usage_quantity
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS total_dbus
  FROM
    system.billing.usage,
    params
  WHERE
    usage_date >= start_date
    AND usage_date <= end_date
    AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    usage_metadata.warehouse_id
),
warehouse_queries AS (
  SELECT
    compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_queries,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN execution_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS completed_queries,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(execution_duration_ms, 0)) / 3600000.0, 2) AS total_query_hours,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(total_duration_ms, 0)) / 3600000.0, 2) AS total_wall_clock_query_hours,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(total_duration_ms, 0)) / 1000.0, 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(waiting_for_compute_duration_ms, 0)) / 1000.0, 2) AS avg_startup_wait_sec,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(waiting_at_capacity_duration_ms, 0)) / 1000.0, 2) AS avg_queue_wait_sec,
    MAX(start_time) AS last_query_time
  FROM
    system.query.history,
    params
  WHERE
    start_time >= start_ts
    AND start_time <= end_ts
    AND compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    compute.warehouse_id
),
warehouse_names AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    warehouse_name,
    warehouse_type,
    warehouse_size,
    auto_stop_minutes,
    min_clusters,
    max_clusters
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        warehouse_name,
        warehouse_type,
        warehouse_size,
        auto_stop_minutes,
        min_clusters,
        max_clusters,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        system.compute.warehouses
    ) latest
  WHERE
    rn = 1
),
pre_window_events AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    event_type,
    cluster_count,
    event_time
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        event_type,
        cluster_count,
        event_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        system.compute.warehouse_events,
        params
      WHERE
        event_time < start_ts
    ) prior_events
  WHERE
    rn = 1
),
window_events AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    event_type,
    cluster_count,
    event_time
  FROM
    system.compute.warehouse_events,
    params
  WHERE
    event_time >= start_ts
    AND event_time <= end_ts
),
events_for_runtime AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    pre_window_events
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    window_events
),
warehouse_runtime AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            COALESCE(cluster_count, 0) > 0
            OR event_type IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING')
          THEN
            GREATEST(
              0,
              UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(COALESCE(next_event_time, end_ts), end_ts))
                - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(GREATEST(event_time, start_ts))
            )
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
        / 3600.0,
      2
    ) AS running_hours,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN event_type = 'RUNNING' THEN event_time
      END
    ) AS last_running_time
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        e.warehouse_id,
        e.event_type,
        e.cluster_count,
        e.event_time,
        LEAD(e.event_time) OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.warehouse_id
            ORDER BY e.event_time
          ) AS next_event_time,
        p.start_ts,
        p.end_ts
      FROM
        events_for_runtime e CROSS JOIN params p
    ) sequenced
  GROUP BY
    warehouse_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(n.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id, q.warehouse_id, r.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id,
  COALESCE(
    n.warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(d.warehouse_id, q.warehouse_id, r.warehouse_id)
  ) AS warehouse_name,
  n.warehouse_type,
  n.warehouse_size,
  n.auto_stop_minutes,
  n.min_clusters,
  n.max_clusters,
  COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) AS total_queries,
  COALESCE(q.completed_queries, 0) AS completed_queries,
  COALESCE(d.total_dbus, 0) AS total_dbus,
  COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0) AS total_query_hours,
  COALESCE(q.total_wall_clock_query_hours, 0) AS total_wall_clock_query_hours,
  COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) AS running_hours,
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0), 0),
    2
  ) AS idle_hours,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN
        COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0), 0)
          / r.running_hours
    END,
    4
  ) AS idle_ratio,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0) / r.running_hours
    END,
    4
  ) AS productivity_ratio,
  COALESCE(q.avg_duration_sec, 0) AS avg_duration_sec,
  COALESCE(q.avg_startup_wait_sec, 0) AS avg_startup_wait_sec,
  COALESCE(q.avg_queue_wait_sec, 0) AS avg_queue_wait_sec,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(d.total_dbus, 0) / q.total_queries, 4)
  END AS dbu_per_query,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0) > 0
    THEN
      ROUND(COALESCE(d.total_dbus, 0) / q.total_query_hours, 4)
  END AS dbu_per_query_hour,
  q.last_query_time,
  r.last_running_time,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) >= 1
      AND COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0) = 0
    THEN
      'Idle without queries'
    WHEN
      COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) >= 1
      AND COALESCE(q.total_query_hours, 0) / NULLIF(r.running_hours, 0) < 0.2
    THEN
      'Low productivity'
    ELSE 'Normal'
  END AS efficiency_status
FROM
  warehouse_names n
    FULL OUTER JOIN warehouse_dbus d
      ON n.warehouse_id = d.warehouse_id
    FULL OUTER JOIN warehouse_queries q
      ON COALESCE(n.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id) = q.warehouse_id
    FULL OUTER JOIN warehouse_runtime r
      ON COALESCE(n.warehouse_id, d.warehouse_id, q.warehouse_id) = r.warehouse_id
WHERE
  (
    COALESCE(d.total_dbus, 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) > 0
  )
  AND (
    n.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
    OR COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(r.running_hours, 0) > 0
  )
ORDER BY
  idle_hours DESC,
  total_dbus DESC

SELECT
  HOUR(start_time) AS hour_of_day,
  COUNT(*) AS query_count,
  ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN execution_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS failed_queries,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(total_duration_ms, 0)) / 3600000.0, 2) AS total_query_hours
FROM
  system.query.history
WHERE
  start_time >= :date_range.min
  AND start_time <= :date_range.max
  AND compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  HOUR(start_time)
ORDER BY
  hour_of_day

datasets.name: wh_query_percentiles

WITH warehouse_names AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    warehouse_name
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        warehouse_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        system.compute.warehouses
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(wn.warehouse_name, qh.compute.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_name,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(qh.total_duration_ms / 1000.0, 0.5), 2) AS p50_duration_sec,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(qh.total_duration_ms / 1000.0, 0.9), 2) AS p90_duration_sec,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(qh.total_duration_ms / 1000.0, 0.99), 2) AS p99_duration_sec,
  COUNT(*) AS query_count
FROM
  system.query.history qh
    LEFT JOIN warehouse_names wn
      ON qh.compute.warehouse_id = wn.warehouse_id
WHERE
  qh.start_time >= :date_range.min
  AND qh.start_time <= :date_range.max
  AND qh.compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(wn.warehouse_name, qh.compute.warehouse_id)
ORDER BY
  query_count DESC

datasets.name: cluster_efficiency
queryLines:
WITH active_clusters AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    cluster_name,
    driver_node_type,
    worker_node_type,
    worker_count,
    max_autoscale_workers,
    policy_id,
    cluster_source,
    delete_time
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        cluster_id,
        cluster_name,
        driver_node_type,
        worker_node_type,
        worker_count,
        max_autoscale_workers,
        policy_id,
        cluster_source,
        delete_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        system.compute.clusters
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
    AND delete_time IS NULL
),
cluster_utilization AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN driver = FALSE THEN cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS avg_worker_cpu_pct,
    ROUND(
      MAX(
        CASE
          WHEN driver = FALSE THEN cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS peak_worker_cpu_pct,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN driver = FALSE THEN mem_used_percent
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS avg_worker_mem_pct,
    ROUND(
      MAX(
        CASE
          WHEN driver = FALSE THEN mem_used_percent
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS peak_worker_mem_pct,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN driver = TRUE THEN cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS avg_driver_cpu_pct,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN driver = TRUE THEN mem_used_percent
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS avg_driver_mem_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(start_time)) AS active_days
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline
  WHERE
    start_time >= :date_range.min
    AND start_time <= :date_range.max
  GROUP BY
    cluster_id
)
SELECT
  ac.cluster_id,
  ac.cluster_name,
  ac.driver_node_type,
  ac.worker_node_type,
  ac.worker_count,
  ac.max_autoscale_workers,
  CASE
    WHEN ac.policy_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS has_policy,
  ac.cluster_source,
  COALESCE(cu.avg_worker_cpu_pct, 0) AS avg_worker_cpu_pct,
  COALESCE(cu.peak_worker_cpu_pct, 0) AS peak_worker_cpu_pct,
  COALESCE(cu.avg_worker_mem_pct, 0) AS avg_worker_mem_pct,
  COALESCE(cu.peak_worker_mem_pct, 0) AS peak_worker_mem_pct,
  COALESCE(cu.avg_driver_cpu_pct, 0) AS avg_driver_cpu_pct,
  COALESCE(cu.avg_driver_mem_pct, 0) AS avg_driver_mem_pct,
  COALESCE(cu.active_days, 0) AS active_days,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(cu.avg_worker_cpu_pct, 0) < 20
      AND COALESCE(cu.active_days, 0) > 0
    THEN
      'Underutilized'
    WHEN COALESCE(cu.avg_worker_cpu_pct, 0) >= 80 THEN 'High utilization'
    WHEN COALESCE(cu.active_days, 0) = 0 THEN 'No activity'
    ELSE 'Normal'
  END AS utilization_status
FROM
  active_clusters ac
    LEFT JOIN cluster_utilization cu
      ON ac.cluster_id = cu.cluster_id
ORDER BY
  avg_worker_cpu_pct ASC
